test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Sushant looked __blue in the face__ after the marathon.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. exhausted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"blue in the face"** means to be extremely tired or exhausted, often after trying very hard to do something. (बेहद थका हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **He argued until he was blue in the face, but she wouldn't change her mind.
 
 
 
• **"Exhausted" **means being very tired or having no energy left, often after physical or mental effort. (थका हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **After running the marathon, she was completely exhausted.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. exhausted.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Happy **(खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

 
 
• **Example:** She was very happy with the surprise party her friends threw for her.
 
 
 
• **Sad **(उदास): Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

 
 
• **Example: **He was sad to hear about the passing of his old friend.
 
 
 
• **Good** (अच्छा): To be desired or approved of.

 
 
• **Example:** She is a good student who always completes her homework on time.
 
 

37:Taf5,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.</p
